PRIVILEGED AND CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY-CLIENT COMMUNICATION / ATTORNEY WORK
 PRODUCT
L&L ASSOCIATES
Outside Counsel — Attorneys at Law
February 24, 2023
VIA EMAIL
John Ellery, Head of Legal, Cascade Timber Holdings
Re: Engagement — Internal Review of Coastal Solar Credit Program
Dear John:
This letter confirms the engagement of L&L Associates (“we” or “the Firm”) by Cascade Timber
Holdings (“CTH” or “the Company”) to provide legal advice and conduct an internal review of the
Coastal Solar Credit Program in connection with the anonymous complaint received on February 20,
2023.
All communications, work product, and materials generated in connection with this engagement are
intended to be, and should be treated as, protected by the attorney-client privilege and/or attorney work
product doctrine. Please direct all custodian and document collection questions to my attention.
We look forward to assisting CTH with this matter.
Sincerely,
Grace Lin, Partner — L&L Associates
